description: SPEC_DASHBOARD section 22: the 20 acceptance criteria of the onboarding capability. LATER rows follow decision G-1 (dashboard projects, repos and configuration are read only in 1.1.0).

criteria.text: A new user can install Sentinel and open the dashboard.
The user can provide or select the Sentinel installation path.
criteria.reference: G-1 (INS-08: the directory picker; the installation path is chosen when Sentinel is installed)

criteria.text: The dashboard can securely validate the installation.
The dashboard can connect to or launch the Sentinel runtime through the trusted local integration.
The dashboard clearly reports missing dependencies and configuration.
The user can create a project without manually editing configuration files.
The user can add multiple repositories to a project.
criteria.reference: G-1 (REP-05; the repository list is read only, AC-REP-03a)

criteria.text: The dashboard validates repository paths and access.
The user can configure providers and agents through the dashboard.
The user can configure workflows and project policies through the dashboard.
The user can configure build, test, lint, and verification commands.
The dashboard validates configuration before activation.
Configuration changes are versioned and auditable.
A project readiness check identifies missing required configuration.
A ready project allows the user to create and start a task immediately.
The first task still follows mandatory specification and Gherkin approval.
A user can return later and manage projects and configuration without terminal-based setup.
Local runtime access and repository permissions are secured.
Existing CLI and file-based configuration workflows remain compatible.
The system does not create a second orchestration engine inside the dashboard.
